text: Every animal adapts to its world. We do the opposite: we adapt the world to us.
subtitle_html:
Every animal adapts to its world.
We do the opposite: we adapt the world to us.

text: Cheetahs have speed. Whales have depth. Physically, humans are outmatched by almost everything in nature.
subtitle_html:
Cheetahs have speed. Whales have depth.
Physically, humans are outmatched by almost everything in nature.

text: Yet a million years ago, we did what no creature dared: we mastered fire. Cooking unlocked the energy that supercharged our brains.
subtitle_html:
Yet a million years ago, we did what no creature dared:
we mastered fire, unlocking energy that supercharged our brains.

text: Ants build cities through instinct. But humans build civilizations through imagination—shared stories, laws, and ideals.
subtitle_html:
Ants build cities through instinct.
Humans build civilizations through shared imagination—stories, laws, and ideals.

text: We are the only animals that contemplate our own existence... and the only ones with the power to protect, or destroy, the world that created us.
subtitle_html:
We are the only animals that contemplate our existence...
and the only ones with the power to protect, or destroy, our world.
